text:
The placement constraints force three blocks: Ben–Elif–Gus in three consecutive slots, Dev–Ann in two consecutive slots, and Ivo with Cara two slots later. Elif before Ann puts the Ben–Elif–Gus block entirely before Dev, and Dev before Ivo puts Dev–Ann before Ivo.

Finn also has to sit at least two slots before Dev. The only positions that leave a legal slot for Finn and for Hana are:

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ben","3":"Elif","4":"Gus","5":"Dev","6":"Ann","7":"Ivo","8":"Hana","9":"Cara"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
